stem: A telemetry team is designing new time-series ingestion on AWS in 2026 and must avoid retired guidance while selecting current cost-aware patterns. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Treat Timestream for LiveAnalytics as closed to new customers during service selection.
Evaluate Timestream for InfluxDB as a current alternative for similar time-series use cases.
Use AWS CloudTrail Lake as the primary high-frequency sensor write database by default.
Use Amazon SES event publishing as the main time-series storage engine.
Use Amazon Lex V2 bot sessions as the durable IoT metric archive.

rationale: The availability change notice says Timestream for LiveAnalytics is closed to new customers and recommends evaluating Timestream for InfluxDB for similar capabilities. CloudTrail Lake, SES, and Lex session storage are not primary general time-series database selections for this requirement.
